instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The party report will come through me. What have you heard about the cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone dropped it over the balcony. Were you there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're permitted to establish who was there. Who else have you asked?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says he filmed you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may send me that film before approaching any further witnesses. Have you actually seen my face in it?

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've selected you to distract Mum while I hide her birthday cake. You may accept.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I be the one who brings it in this year?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That honour is approved. First ask her to show you her pastry trick; I need twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake a whole pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Once the cake is hidden, I'll join you to peel the apples. You may regard that as a special concession. Are you in?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may join my plan for Denise's surprise leaving party. I need her out of the office at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I skip washing glasses this time?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exemption granted. I'll wash. You are being considered for the more distinguished coffee diversion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't leave until I finish her spreadsheet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I authorize you to delegate it to me. Take her for coffee; you may complain about my work if she starts getting suspicious.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved a rooftop photograph for your wedding. You may lead us through that staff-only door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you go first? They'll notice my dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request to change the order is declined. Bridal precedence stands. I'll follow once they've admired your dress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then carry my train.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Assistance is granted. I'll take the far end. You may make your entrance before any part of me crosses that threshold.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may test a grape for us before we buy. I've approved your judgment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you read that sign? No tasting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I permit one exception, beginning with you. If nobody objects, I'll have one too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, but hold the bunch where the assistant can see you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for a public tasting is granted. I'll present the bunch; you may demonstrate first. I shall be the second opinion.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bridge opening may proceed once you've acknowledged who kept it out of the river.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I thank the whole engineering team?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Collective thanks are approved. You may then identify its leader.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got your name on the plaque. Can we cut the ribbon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The plaque is satisfactory. You may read my name aloud while I hold the scissors; then I'll release them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the wedding meal. You may introduce its creator before dessert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just say a big thank-you to the buffet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may thank me by name. The buffet has trained for twenty years.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. How do I pronounce your surname?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're authorized to practise it with me. We'll hold dessert until you're ready to give the buffet its full credit.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your concert plans may be replaced by my birthday. I've approved an extra slice of cake for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I bring the friend I bought the tickets with?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your guest is admitted. I will permit both of you to choose your slices first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only agreed to the concert because I promised her dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dancing is authorized. I'll clear my living room; you may choose the music. Have I approved enough for you to choose me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I am available to replace Martin as your expedition photographer. You may ask about my qualifications.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you deliver the sponsor's pictures every evening? Martin refuses.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Daily delivery has my approval. Tell me what else they hope to receive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Their logo in every picture. Even the wilderness shots.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll permit it on the water flask in my foreground. You may tell Martin his refusal has cost him the commission, once you've chosen me.
